entities.summary: The serpent, or snake, is one of the oldest and most widespread mythological symbols. The word is derived from Latin serpens, a crawling animal or snake. Snakes have been associated with some of the oldest rituals known to humankind. serpent is a symbol. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
